description: This file is a shell script for configuring and managing a git-instaweb server, including starting, stopping, and restarting various web server backends (lighttpd, apache, webrick, mongoose, plackup, python) for serving gitweb. It contains functions for setting up server configurations, resolving server paths, and launching the server with specific options.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the HTTP server executable based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the configured web server, handling process management and configuration setup.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running web server by killing its process.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the web server has started and is listening on the specified port.

methods.name: gitweb_conf
methods.description: Creates the default gitweb configuration file.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Configures the web server based on the specified server type.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Sets up a Python-based web server for gitweb.

methods.name: lighttpd_conf
methods.description: Sets up a lighttpd configuration for gitweb.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Sets up an Apache2 configuration for gitweb.

methods.name: mongoose_conf
methods.description: Sets up a Mongoose web server configuration for gitweb.

methods.name: plackup_conf
methods.description: Creates a standalone PSGI server script for gitweb using Plack.

search-terms: shell script for web server management
